name: Nike Air Max 90 SP 'Reverse Duck Camo' 2020
story_html: The 2024 edition of the Nike Air Max 90 SP 'Reverse Duck Camo' previously released in 2020, delivering a color-flipped version of the 'Duck Camo' Atmos collaboration from 2013. A black lizard-textured Swoosh adorns the upper, crafted from Infrared mesh with duck camo leather on the midfoot overlay and mudguard. Anchoring the sneaker is a lightweight polyurethane midsole with visible Air-sole cushioning in the heel.
